'''Tsiat''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]] of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] present at the [[New Jedi Temple]] during [[Assault on the New Jedi Temple|the last battle]] between [[Abeloth]] and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]; he was ordered to keep watch to their prisoner [[Wynn Dorvan]], but Wynn managed to liberate himself and took Tsiat's blaster.
